mapper.select: SELECT id, storage_id, storage_no, purchase_detail_id, asset_code, asset_name, spec, manufacturer, unit, storage_quantity, price, total_price, remark, create_time, update_time FROM asset_in_storage_detail WHERE storage_id = #{storageId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, storage_id, storage_no, purchase_detail_id, asset_code, asset_name, spec, manufacturer, unit, storage_quantity, price, total_price, remark, create_time, update_time FROM asset_in_storage_detail WHERE storage_no = #{storageNo} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset_in_storage_detail (storage_id, storage_no, purchase_detail_id, asset_code, asset_name, spec, manufacturer, unit, storage_quantity, price, total_price, remark) VALUES (#{storageId}, #{storageNo}, #{purchaseDetailId}, #{assetCode}, #{assetName}, #{spec}, #{manufacturer}, #{unit}, #{storageQuantity}, #{price}, #{totalPrice}, #{remark})
